collection.title: Ford Tourneo Connect (with Split Rear Door) 2002 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 2002 to 2012 version of a Ford Tourneo Connect requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Tourneo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
